row: Dr. Heather, DPT | Pediatric Therapy Essentials

My name is Dr. Heather. I'm a Physical Therapist with over 27 years of experience in pediatrics. I have both my Masters and Doctorate in Physical Therapy. I'm also a Board Certified Clinical Specialist in Pediatrics.

Throughout my career I have worked in Early Intervention, Public Schools, and Private Practice. I've owned and operated 2 private practices which allowed me to combine my loves for physical therapy and entrepreneurship. I created this channel to  provide education, support, and resources to families, educators, and professionals.
